object: FOLD//BLOOM LISTEN addressed annotations + dual-phone saber crystallization

user_feedback: LISTEN showed two grey PIN controls despite a loaded/map-ready MP3.
Annotation should grow toward bookmarks, flags, arcs/spans, tweaking and information sharing.
Beat Saber pack/export was useful but did not satisfy the intended in-Fold/Bloom playable mode; two phones as sabers is the desired direction.
Local MP3 loading is acceptable now; future installed/PWA use may improve local playlist intake for other people.
Voice and other experiment surfaces are useful but have follow-ups; continuity should not drift across parallel threads.

shipped: Root-cause fix: LISTEN resynchronizes MARK/MARKS after PREVIEW and DEEP map creation, so controls no longer stay disabled from the pre-map loadPins() state.
Backward-compatible addressed mark model: BOOKMARK point, FLAG point+intent, ARC current-aperture span.
Renderer gives FLAG and ARC distinct witnesses while old point pins remain readable.
Addressed-message RETURN advances to v0.2 with kind and endAddress.
SHARE MARKS emits fold-bloom-annotations/v0.1 with source identity + authored marks; source bytes are not included.
Phone continuity smoke now requires enabled mark controls, nonzero ARC span, persistence through reload, and unchanged LISTEN→LIVE exact-source continuity.

saber.law: Beat Saber external pack export != playable FOLD//BLOOM saber runtime.
saber.target: Two phones act as LEFT/RIGHT motion controllers against existing source transport + EVENT TAPE; durable output is bounded HIT TRACE, not raw continuous sensor retention.

pwa_boundary: A future PWA may improve user-selected local files/playlists, remembered browser-local media and offline shell. It must not claim silent access to a device music library; user-granted source access remains the boundary.

verification.full_regression: PASS · Beat Saber pack, Voice, INK, LAB, LIVE, unified root and critical browser smoke
